An '''Unidentified giant tentacled serpent''' inhabited the barren [[Desert/Legends|desert]] wastelands of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carreras Minor]]. While evading the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system's]] security forces, the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]] and her companions, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Sauk]] and the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[AG-37]], landed [[AG-37's freighter|their freighter]] on Carreras Minor. They were quickly attacked by the monster but were rescued by the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]]. In the end, they managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the monster by firing the freighter's [[Engine/Legends|thruster engines]] at its face, [[Fire/Legends|incinerating]] it.
